lines.text: चन्द्रयोगाध्याय:
Yogas for Moon
अधमसमवरिष्ठान्यर्ककेन्द्रादिसंस्थे
शशिनि विनयवित्तज्ञानधीनैपुणानि।
अहनि निशि च चन्द्रे स्वेऽधिमित्रांशके वा
सुरगुरुसितदृष्टे वित्तवान् स्यात्सुखी चा। 1 ।।
When Moon is located in Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th and 10th)
from the Sun, the person has the least of good manners, wealth
knowledge, efficiency in action (due to influence of Sun on
her). When she is in houses (2nd, 5th, 8th and 11th) from the
Sun these qualities etc are possessed by the native in small
measure. In case she occupies 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th from the
Sun, these are acquired in good measure. In the case of a day
birth, when Moon is located in her own or a friendly navamsha
and is aspected by Jupiter or when it is a night birth, and she
is similarly situated in navamsha and aspected by Venus, the
native becomes wealthy and leads a comfortable life.
Commentary: Moon is one of the greatest, if not the great-
est, factors of wealth. Its strength is conducive to wealth as
would be borne out also by the following shlokas.
Adhiyoga of Moon
सौम्यै: स्मरारिनिधनेष्वधियोग इन्दो-
स्तस्मिंश्चमूपसचिवक्षितिपालजन्म।
